title: AI Automation Engineer
description:
**About E2M**

E2M Solutions works as a trusted white-label partner for digital agencies. We support agencies with consistent and reliable delivery through services such as website design, web development, eCommerce, SEO, AI SEO, PPC, AI automation, and content writing.Founded on strong business ethics, we are an equal opportunity organization powered by 350+ experienced professionals, partnering with 400+ digital agencies across the US, UK, Canada, Europe, and Australia. At E2M, we value ownership, consistency, and people who are committed to doing meaningful work and growing together. If you’re someone who dreams big and has the gumption to make them come true, E2M has a place for you

**Role Overview**

As an **AI Automation Engineer** who can design and build end-to-end AI automation solutions using LLMs, agents, tools, APIs, and MCP. The role focuses on building practical, production-ready AI systems and automation workflows rather than traditional ML model training.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Design and build **end-to-end AI automation and agentic architectures**.
* Build workflows using **LLMs, agents, tools, APIs, and MCP**.
* Design and implement tools that allow AI systems to interact with applications and external services.
* Integrate LLM APIs and SDKs into production applications.
* Build multi-step workflows with proper context, state, validation, and error handling.
* Develop backend APIs and integrations required for AI-powered features.
* Debug and improve AI workflows for reliability, performance, and scalability.
* Take features from requirements and architecture through implementation and production.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

  

* 1–3 years of software engineering or AI application development experience.
* Strong understanding of:
  + Agentic architecture
  + Agentic loops
  + Tool / function calling
  + MCP
  + Context engineering
  + Prompt engineering
  + Structured outputs
  + Workflow orchestration
* Experience working with LLM APIs and SDKs.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs and system integrations.
* Good programming skills in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar languages.
* Ability to understand and design **end-to-end system architecture**.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of features.

**Good to Have**

  

* Experience building MCP servers or custom AI tools.
* Experience with AI-assisted development workflows.
* Experience with Docker and cloud deployment.
* Exposure to Container Apps, Key Vault, or similar cloud services.

**What We Expect**

  

* Ability to take an AI use case from **concept**  **architecture**  **implementation**  **production**.
* Strong understanding of how agents, tools, APIs, context, and application systems work together.
* Ability to learn new AI technologies and apply them quickly.
* Strong ownership and practical problem-solving ability.

title: Automation Engineer - HVAC
description:
Automation Design \& Development

* Design automation solutions for AHU manufacturing and testing applications.
* Develop PLC, HMI, and SCADA programs as per project requirements.
* Prepare automation architecture, I/O lists, and control philosophies.
* Select suitable automation components including PLCs, HMIs, VFDs, sensors, and communication devices.
* Support electrical design team during control panel development.

Programming \& Integration

* Develop and modify PLC programs using ladder logic, function block, and structured text.
* Configure and program HMI screens for machine operation and monitoring.
* Integrate PLCs with SCADA systems, VFDs, sensors, and field instruments.
* Establish communication using Modbus, Profinet, Profibus, Ethernet/IP, BACnet, and other industrial protocols.

Testing \& Commissioning

* Conduct FAT (Factory Acceptance Test) and SAT (Site Acceptance Test).
* Perform machine testing, troubleshooting, and validation.
* Commission AHU testing stations and automation\-controlled equipment.
* Support installation and startup activities at customer sites.

Troubleshooting \& Maintenance

* Diagnose automation\-related breakdowns and control system faults.
* Provide technical support to production and maintenance departments.
* Implement corrective and preventive actions to minimize downtime.
* Maintain backup copies of PLC, HMI, and SCADA programs.

Documentation

* Prepare technical documentation, operating manuals, and commissioning reports.
* Create I/O lists, cable schedules, and automation drawings.
* Maintain project records, revision histories, and software backups.

Process Improvement

* Identify opportunities for automation and process optimization.
* Improve production efficiency through automation initiatives.
* Support Industry 4\.0 and digitalization projects.
* Participate in continuous improvement and cost\-reduction activities.

Required Skills

* PLC Programming (Siemens, Allen Bradley, Schneider, Delta, Mitsubishi, Omron, etc.)
* HMI/SCADA Development
* VFD Configuration \& Troubleshooting
* Industrial Communication Protocols
* Electrical Control Panels
* Instrumentation \& Sensors
* AutoCAD Electrical (Preferred)
* Industrial Networking
* Troubleshooting \& Root Cause Analysis
* Project Execution \& Documentation

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
